titel: The Case of the Missing Painting
text:
Lina and Jack are members of the school detective club. On Friday, the school has an art show in the big hall. Everyone brings a painting. At ten o'clock, Lina's friend Zoe shouts, "My painting is gone!"

Lina and Jack look at the wall. There is only an empty frame. On the floor, they see small spots of green paint. The spots go out of the hall and along the corridor. Jack follows them to the art room.

The door is open. Inside, Mr Ford, the art teacher, is working at a table. In front of him is Zoe's painting. He looks up and smiles. "I'm sorry," he says. "The frame was broken, so I wanted to fix it before the show starts. I forgot to tell anyone."

Together they carry the painting back to the hall. Zoe is happy again, and the detectives write a new line in their notebook: Case closed.

aufgaben.frage: What colour are the spots on the floor?
Why does he take the painting?
